response_raw:
HouseTask
agents:
	humans: Human
	robots: Robot
locations: bedroom, kitchen
resources: object

Human:
	1: moveTo bedroom
	2: moveTo kitchen
	3: follow Robot(kitchen)

Robot:
	1: moveTo bedroom
	2: pick object
	3: moveTo kitchen
	4: follow Human(kitchen)

success: position(Human, kitchen) && position(Robot, kitchen) && possess(Robot, object)
failure: !position(Human, kitchen) || !position(Robot, kitchen) || !possess(Robot, object)
